newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin ends two cents down at 15.17 rgt.
newsitem.headline: KL tin ends two cents down at 15.17 rgt.

text.p: Tin price ended two cents lower at 15.17 ringgit ($6.08) a kg on a lower close in London overnight and reduced buying demand, traders said.

"The market was a bit easier because of falls in London and less buying," a dealer said, adding that buying was from Europe and locally. Turnover fell to 123 tonnes from 206 tonnes on Monday, and the local premium over the London market was unchanged at $5 a tonne.
The local price trend would continue to depend on the performance of the copper market in London, traders said.
